version.value: Traditional Latin plainchant, identified by the performer as mode III; solo voice
version.note: The source names the chant version but does not identify a printed edition. Gregorian chant is a repertory designation, not an attribution to Pope Gregory.

authorship.value: Traditional melody; text by Thomas Aquinas
authorship.note: The text is distinguished from the earlier Pange lingua Passion hymn usually credited to Venantius Fortunatus. Aquinas is not credited as composer of the melody.

date.note: The text belongs to the thirteenth century. The date of the traditional tune is not established; no exact medieval year is supplied.

completeness.value: Whole nominated Pange lingua file, not its cropped Tantum ergo derivative
completeness.note: Commons separately lists the derivative Tantum Ergo I Gregorian.ogg. The original file is retained without a new edit; individual stanza words have not been aligned.

performers.note: The file description explicitly names the singer; uploader Garzo is linked in that description. No instrumental accompaniment or additional singer is credited.

date.note: The prose explicitly says recorded on this date. This is not inferred solely from the same-day upload timestamp.

place.note: No recording venue or town is given. A singer’s residence or profile is not substituted for the session location.

label.note: An original recording label or imprint is not identified; Commons is the repository.

catalogue.note: No release catalogue number is supplied.

matrixTakeSides.note: No original session carrier, matrix or take number is documented.

credits.note: The singer/uploader is documented, but a separate recording or mastering engineer is not named.

date.note: The recording and upload date does not establish a separate conversion or mastering date.

processing.value: Ogg Vorbis source; Wikimedia MP3 access derivative
processing.note: Embedded software is Xiph.Org libVorbis I 20020717. No microphone, editing, equalisation, noise reduction or pitch correction is documented. Contrapunctus has not trimmed the file.
